service.en: Renew domestic worker contract and residence
service.ar: تجديد عقد عمل عامل خدمة منزلية
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کے معاہدے کی تجدید

about: An employer renews a domestic worker's work contract and residence permit.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: AED 215 for one year (citizen, GCC or diplomatic)
AED 315 for two years (citizen, GCC or diplomatic)
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
Provided by Ministry of Human Resources & Emiratisation
